checks: Fixed immutable public bank path and byte hash verified independently; no input path supplied at runtime.
One fixed READ ONLY PostgreSQL query, default read-only connection, pg_catalog search path, bounded command and statement deadlines.
Only corpus metadata and JSON comparisons are evaluated inside PostgreSQL; no participant, answer or session tables referenced.
Exactly nine literal-named Boolean predicates accepted; no version, bank, codebook or digest values output.
Absent version, nonunique version, unequal bank and codebook/digest shapes are distinct observations.
No approved codebook reference or combined-digest equality is claimed.
limitations: Raw JSONB equality is not alone proof of a runtime initialization failure; actual application guard must be checked.
Codebook and digest values are inspected only inside PostgreSQL to compute declared shapes; this is not independent content validation.
No type/schema/ACL/adoption or full startup guarantee follows from this restored-state probe.
Author two native tests are source/result reviewed, not rerun by this reviewer.
scope: independent source review of fixed public-corpus comparison and private-reference shape projection
